references.text: The priests shall keep watch at the entrance to the tabernacle and follow the Lord's command, so that they do not die.
Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord and profaned the service.
The one who keeps the Lord's statutes and laws shall live by them.
The one who profanes what is holy shall bear their sin and be cut off from their people.
The Lord is the one who sanctifies his people.
The Lord is the one who sanctifies the priests.
The Lord is the one who sanctifies the priests and their descendants.
The priests must not profane what is holy, or they will die.
The Levites shall keep watch and take care of the sanctuary.
The warning not to profane the holy offerings of the Israelites, so that they do not die.
The priests must follow the regulations when approaching the altar, so that they do not incur guilt and die.
The Lord is the one who sanctifies Israel.
Ezekiel warns against failing to keep watch over what is holy.
